newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures slip on technical selling.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures slip on technical selling.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures extended their early losses to mostly end at the day's lows on Wednesday, as technical selling by private investors gathered force, traders said.
There were no special factors behind today's falls, but charts suggested the market was technically bearish.
The benchmark March 1998 contract closed 490 yen lower at 15,820 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 51,637 lots.
One trader said initial support for the benchmark March was seen at 15,740 yen, adding signs that the yen's recent fall had stalled, also undermined market sentiment.
The spot March contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $3.02-1/2 per bushel at 0847 GMT, against $3.03-3/4 at Tuesday's close.
The CBOT soybean futures spot March contract was at $8.07-1/4 at 0847 GMT, up from $8.06-1/2 at Tuesday's close.
